prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends entirely on your goals, budget, industry, and level of hands‑on involvement you want. I can help you find the best fit. Quick questions to narrow it down:

- What are your primary goals? (e.g., brand awareness, lead gen, e‑commerce revenue, app installs, SEO, paid media, content, social)
- What’s your monthly marketing budget or retainer range?
- Company stage and size? (startup, SMB, enterprise)
- Industry or target market (B2B SaaS, consumer, healthcare, fintech, etc.)
- Timeline/urgency and preferred engagement model (project, monthly retainer, performance‑based)
- Do you need an agency local to San Francisco or is remote OK?

If you want to start searching right away, here’s a simple vetting checklist and resources:

How to evaluate agencies
- Relevant case studies and measurable outcomes (ROAS, lead cost, traffic growth)
- Experience in your industry or with businesses of your size
- Clear KPIs, reporting cadence, and tools they use (GA4, Looker, HubSpot, etc.)
- Team makeup and senior access (will senior people handle your account?)
- Contract flexibility and cancellation terms
- References from current/previous clients

Where to look
- Clutch.co and G2 for reviews and rankings
- Google Partners directory for certified PPC/Ads agencies
- LinkedIn for client lists and employee backgrounds
- Local industry meetups and referrals from other founders/CMOs

Red flags
- Vague promises (“we’ll get you #1 on Google”)
- No case studies or unwillingness to share references
- Locked‑in multi‑year contracts with no performance clauses
- Poor transparency on fees and reporting

If you want, tell me the answers to the questions above and I’ll shortlist 4–6 San Francisco agencies that match your needs (with strengths, estimated pricing, and suggested interview questions). Which direction do you want to go?
